mentions.name: Handy
mentions.description: Open-source, cross-platform dictation app similar to SuperWhisper that transcribes speech to text using whisper.cpp, with acceleration on most devices via the Vulkan backend.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on https://handy.computer. It's similar to SuperWhisper and others, but is open source and cross platform

It uses whisper.cpp under the hood and should be accelerated on most devices using the Vulkan backend
